intent: Give the two evaluation-batch ideas that both get called baseline one name each, so code, contract and documents stop using one word for two things.
observable_outcome: An Agent that asks what baseline means is told it is a name to avoid and is pointed at Skill withheld or Reference batch, each with a reviewed definition; the vocabulary-synonyms gate then fails any new use of the avoided names.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The Run that does not load the Skill and the batch a comparison measures against are two reviewed terms, each defined by the decision that owns evaluation batches.
Asking for baseline, without skill or no skill returns the terms as synonym matches, not as names.
Once the terms are reviewed, a contract key or an identifier in their Contexts that uses an avoided name fails automation-check unless it is held in the baseline.
The approval that makes the terms reviewed is checkable outside the package.
